title: smaller pot holders
text: smaller pot holders. I purchased these to use with my toaster oven - replacing some other with the same shape, but slightly smaller and didn't have the silicone dots.  The old ones literally collapsed and become garbage within about 1 month of using.  These are THE BOMB!  I never put my fingers in the pockets - you don't have to - but you can if you want to.  The silicone dots are super useful - holding whatever pan you have steady and still.  You get three sets of two, 6 pot holders in total.  Three different very bright and cheery colors.  The silicone dots are white.  I haven't washed and dried them yet, but I fully expect them to do beautifully - but I will wash them separately because of the silicone dots - they could tend to stick to other items in a load. To me, we they are the best I have found toaster oven pot holders I've ever found.  Heck, they could totally be fine with your regular size stove!  Having said all of this, I never hesitate to update my reviews should new info seem useful.
